The ConPTY terminal (ovis-terminal-holder windows::ConptyTerminal) and terminal.run admission (lanes::conpty::admit/spawn) exist, but no served binary routes terminal.run to them: todo 54 serves named pipes and the Windows service host that owns ConPTY holders, todo 31 assembles the served terminal.run, and the todo-21 runner's fixture serves only a Unix socket, so a windows-only case would be skipped on every runner it has. Covered meanwhile by the native Windows tests listed in the descriptor, run by ci.yml on windows-2025; todo 60 runs this scenario in Windows smoke CI.

machine.add/get/rename are served only by dispatchers assembled in the todo-43 lane tests: no served binary registers the lane until todo 31 assembles it, and the scenario needs two private runtimes joined by a stdio transport plus the plan's --inject/--append runner flags, which the todo-21 runner (one fixture per case) does not have; todo 52 composes remote dispatch across two private runtimes over real endpoints.

doc.get/doc.set are registered by dispatch::lanes::documents_retention on a Dispatcher whose event type carries doc.changed (DocumentsRetentionEvent). The runner's only fixture (todo 21) serves Dispatcher<OperationEvent, OperationProducer> with file-effect doc.* stubs that protocol/* scenarios depend on, and the runner has no --inject/--append or virtual-clock step. It runs once assembly (todo 52, blocked by this todo) serves the lane on the real binary; until then crates/ovis-terminal-server/tests/documents_retention.rs drives the same requests over a real socket.

plugin.* routes exist (crates/ovis-terminal-server/src/dispatch/lanes/plugins.rs) but no served process registers them: todo 52 composes service lanes into the real server, and the todo-21 fixture registers only doc.set/doc.get/terminal.keep and has no --inject/--append/principal_fixture support. Covered meanwhile by the real-socket tests in lanes::plugins.

The worktree lane (crates/ovis-terminal-server/src/dispatch/lanes/worktrees.rs) is registered by assembly; the runner's only fixture kind ('protocol') does not register service lanes, the runner has no --inject/--append flags, and the layout-backed Workspaces owner arrives with todo 42. It becomes executable when todo 31 serves the real binary with assembled lanes (todo 42).
